title: Choosing a cooperative rule is not enough
artifact_scope: Offline reproduction of reported experiments, visible prompts, scores, statistics and figures from cleaned research data. Live provider logs, credentials, billing, development artifacts and report documents are not distributed.
statistical_units: Whole source blocks; repeated matched responses are averaged within their block.
matched_reset_scope: The final message retains the second public round; only earlier turns are removed.
changed_subset_check: Exploratory review-requested analysis, not a replacement primary.

provenance.request_index: SHA256 fingerprints of original visible inputs and parsed answers; no raw API logs included
provenance.code: Pure game/prompt/statistical functions extracted from the completed experiments; standalone packaging and validation were added after data collection.

references.title: CoopEval: Benchmarking Cooperation-Sustaining Mechanisms and LLM Agents in Social Dilemmas
references.contribution: Prior games and mechanism families; experiment implementation and interventions developed during this sprint.
